# Loyalkard

> Loyalkard is digital stamp card software for cafés, restaurants, bakeries and independent retail. Customers scan a counter QR code to join, collect staff-verified stamps in their phone browser, and redeem a reward QR when the card is full. No app download is required for customers.

## Key pages

- Home: https://stamp.v4stay.com/
- Pricing: https://stamp.v4stay.com/pricing

- Contact: https://stamp.v4stay.com/contact

## Product facts

- Built for independent cafés, restaurants, bakeries and retail shops.
- Counter QR codes rotate every five minutes and are single-use.
- Returning visits require staff approval, which blocks screenshot and photo reuse.
- Loyalty mutations are processed server-side.
- The owner dashboard shows customers, visits, redemptions, reviews and reservations.
- Customers can leave private feedback and are guided to Google reviews after positive ratings.
- Loyalkard is a product of V4Stay.
